svg.title: Kingdom of the Fold — Folded Valley tactical map
svg.desc: Map design reference with an isometric papercraft valley concept and a 32 by 20 grid showing curved main route, feeder route, river, bridges, tower sites, hero areas and Heartkeep.
svg.text: Illustrative isometric design reference · verify routes, sockets and walkability in the game.
Curved road · feeder merge · defended bridges · elevated sockets
The hero moves across open terrain rather than following the road.

g.text: 01 · Enemy movement follows actual rounded route geometry.
02 · Tower sockets are deliberate 2×2 placement sites.
03 · River crossings leave walkable bridge approaches.
04 · The hero has connections between major regions.
05 · Six labels are region concepts, not hard-coded tiles.
06 · Concept only; validate generation and balance in Godot.
